<thought>This team is a balanced BSS core built around Gholdengo's Ghost/Steel typing and Dragonite's Multiscale setup power. Garchomp and Kingambit provide strong physical pressure and priority, while Hatterene offers Trick Room / Magic Bounce utility and Rotom-Wash gives pivot support with Volt Switch and Will-O-Wisp. The team covers most major threats in the format with good offensive and defensive synergy.</thought>

<thought>Gholdengo runs Nasty Plot with Make It Rain/Shadow Ball coverage and Recover to sweep late. Dragonite uses Multiscale with Dragon Dance and Roost to set up on weakened teams. Garchomp (Rough Skin) provides Stealth Rock and fast physical pressure, Kingambit cleans with Sucker Punch under Supreme Overlord, Hatterene offers Trick Room and Magic Bounce anti-hazard utility, and Rotom-Wash pivots with Volt Switch and burns physical attackers.</thought>
